items.label: Years of excellence in the railway industry
Design, build, install and service under one roof

blocks.heading: Precision that keeps fleets moving
paragraphs: A railway wheel carries tonnes on a contact patch the size of a coin. Its profile decides ride quality, rail wear, energy consumption and – above all – safety. HYT Engineering exists to restore that profile quickly and accurately, and to give workshops the machines they need to build and overhaul wheelsets with confidence.

Headquartered in Pune, India, we have spent more than four decades concentrating on one discipline: railway wheel and axle machining. Our engineers design every machine in-house, build it in our own facility, commission it on site and support it for decades after handover.
bullets: Specialist focus on wheelset machining and workshop equipment
Machines engineered around Indian and international wheel profiles and gauges
Single-point responsibility from foundation drawing to lifetime service

blocks.heading: CNC underfloor wheel lathes
paragraphs: An underfloor wheel lathe re-profiles wheels while the wheelset stays in the vehicle. The train is drawn over a pit, the axle is lifted on drive rollers and both wheels are machined at the same time – no bogie drop, no brake gear removal, no long shutdown.

HYT underfloor lathes combine rigid machine structures with automatic profile measurement, so the CNC removes only the material that is needed. The result is more re-profiling cycles per wheel, longer wheel life and more trains available for service.
bullets: Single machines (YUL-08, YUGL) and synchronised tandem pairs (YUL-12T, YUGLX)
Both wheels of a wheelset machined simultaneously
Suitable for locomotives, coaches, EMUs, metro cars and wagons
blocks.image_alt: HYT CNC Tandem Underfloor Wheel Lathe (YUL-12T)

blocks.heading: Vertical turning lathes and axle machining
paragraphs: New wheelsets and major overhauls begin in the wheel and axle shop. Our CNC vertical turning and boring machines finish wheel discs, tyres and bores to tight tolerances, while dedicated axle lathes turn and burnish journals for reliable bearing seats.
Combined with wheel presses, measuring stations and dynamic balancing machines, these machines form a complete, traceable process from raw component to certified wheelset.
